fonts.display: 'Perfectly Nineties Regular', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Signal Blue
palette.role: Primary action buttons, active states, brand icon highlights, inline links — the only chromatic accent in an otherwise achromatic system. iOS-native vivid blue that makes functional elements feel switched on

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Headings, primary borders, button text — maximum-contrast structural color

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Body text, secondary borders — softer than black for sustained reading on white

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Muted helper text, metadata labels, subtle borders

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Ash Mist
palette.role: Page canvas background, soft glow rings around cards and images, pale elevation halos
